CreateAndAnalyzeNetworkPath.title: CreateAndAnalyzeNetworkPath
CreateAndAnalyzeNetworkPath.summary: Initiates a task for analyzing network reachability.

CreateNetworkPath.title: CreateNetworkPath
CreateNetworkPath.summary: Creates a network path for reachability analysis.

CreateNetworkReachableAnalysis.title: CreateNetworkReachableAnalysis
CreateNetworkReachableAnalysis.summary: Creates a task for analyzing network reachability.

DeleteNetworkReachableAnalysis.title: DeleteNetworkReachableAnalysis
DeleteNetworkReachableAnalysis.summary: Deletes a task for analyzing network reachability.

DescribeNisInspectionRecommendationResou.title: Query anomalous instances in an inspection report
DescribeNisInspectionRecommendationResou.summary: Queries the list of anomalous instances in an inspection report.

DescribeNisInspectionReportCheckItems.title: DescribeNisInspectionReportCheckItems
DescribeNisInspectionReportCheckItems.summary: Describes the details of check items in an inspection report.

DescribeNisInspectionReportStatus.title: Query inspection report status
DescribeNisInspectionReportStatus.summary: Queries the status of an inspection report.

DescribeNisInspectionReportSummary.title: Query inspection report summary
DescribeNisInspectionReportSummary.summary: Queries the summary of an inspection report.

DescribeNisInspectionTask.title: DescribeNisInspectionTask
DescribeNisInspectionTask.summary: Queries the details of an inspection task.

DescribeNisTrafficRanking.title: Query NIS traffic ranking analysis results
DescribeNisTrafficRanking.summary: Queries NIS traffic ranking analysis results.

GetInternetTuple.title: Retrieve internet traffic detail rankings
GetInternetTuple.summary: Retrieves Internet traffic details ranked by tuple granularity (1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple), with support for sorting by metrics such as traffic volume and packet count.

GetNatTopN.title: GetNatTopN
GetNatTopN.summary: Queries the real-time SNAT performance ranking of a NAT gateway.

GetNetworkReachableAnalysis.title: Obtain network reachability analysis results
GetNetworkReachableAnalysis.summary: Calls the GetNetworkReachableAnalysis operation to obtain the results of a network reachability analysis task.

GetNisNetworkMetrics.title: Retrieve cloud network metric trends
GetNisNetworkMetrics.summary: Retrieves detailed monitoring metric trends data for a specified NIS network analysis scenario, including traffic metric trends for network traffic analysis scenarios and performance metric trends for performance observation scenarios.

GetNisNetworkRanking.title: Retrieve cloud network metric rankings
GetNisNetworkRanking.summary: Supports ranking analysis of traffic flowing through different cloud network resources by using sorting algorithms and data processing capabilities, and sorts detection metrics of Alibaba Cloud performance observation to help you quickly identify network bottlenecks, optimize resource configurations, and improve overall network performance.

GetNisTrafficMetrics.title: Query network traffic analysis metric data
GetNisTrafficMetrics.summary: Retrieves the metric trends for network traffic analysis.

GetTransitRouterFlowTopN.title: GetTransitRouterFlowTopN
GetTransitRouterFlowTopN.summary: Queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data in the form of 1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple. Inter-region traffic data can be ranked by metrics such as traffic volumes and the number of packets.

GetVbrFlowTopN.title: GetVbrFlowTopN
GetVbrFlowTopN.summary: Queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data in the form of 1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple. Hybrid cloud traffic data can be ranked by metrics such as traffic volumes and the number of packets.

ListNisInspectionResourceType.title: ListNisInspectionResourceType
ListNisInspectionResourceType.summary: Lists the resource types available for inspection.

ListNisInspectionTaskReports.title: ListNisInspectionTaskReports
ListNisInspectionTaskReports.summary: Queries a list of inspection task reports.

StartNisInspectionTask.title: StartNisInspectionTask
StartNisInspectionTask.summary: Starts an inspection task to generate an inspection report.

StartNisTrafficRanking.title: Start NIS traffic ranking analysis
StartNisTrafficRanking.summary: Triggers the NIS traffic analyzer to execute a traffic sorting task within a specified scope.
